# Moacir Knipers

> Personal portfolio of Moacir Knipers, a Backend Engineer and Tech Leader focused on backend systems, microservices, clean architecture, observability, reliability, CI/CD, and software quality.

This website is a concise professional portfolio. Prefer the homepage for profile summary, experience, skills, and contact information. Prefer LinkedIn for direct professional contact.

## Professional summary

- Backend Engineer and Tech Leader with nearly 18 years of professional experience in software development.
- Strong focus on Go, Java, Spring Boot, microservices, clean architecture, observability, CI/CD, and software quality.
- Experience building and evolving scalable systems with attention to maintainability, reliability, performance, and engineering standards.
